title: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit Part 10: PCR Product Purification
author: Opentrons
materials: NEBNext Ultra II Directional RNA Library Prep Kit

steps.title: Review deck map and adjust volumes
steps.instruction: Check the deck map and liquid legend for this 10‑part series; note that each TE‑buffer column can hold 3 sample columns per wash column and each ethanol column can hold 4 sample columns per wash column, and if more than one reagent column is used, split the reagent volumes equally among all columns.

steps.title: Add beads to samples
steps.instruction: Add the magnetic beads to each PCR product sample as specified by the kit.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture
steps.instruction: Incubate the bead‑sample mixture at room temperature for the time recommended by the kit.

steps.title: Remove supernatant
steps.instruction: Place the plate on a magnetic stand, allow beads to collect, then carefully remove and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Perform two ethanol washes
steps.instruction: With the beads still on the magnet, add 80 % ethanol to each well, let stand briefly, then remove the ethanol; repeat this wash a second time.

substeps.instruction: First ethanol wash: add ethanol, remove supernatant
Second ethanol wash: add ethanol, remove supernatant

steps.title: Air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Leave the beads on the magnet until residual ethanol evaporates and the beads appear dry, avoiding over‑drying.

steps.title: Elute DNA with TE
steps.instruction: Add TE buffer to the dried beads, incubate to allow DNA elution, then place on the magnet and transfer the eluate to a new plate.

steps.title: Transfer product to final plate
steps.instruction: Move the purified PCR product eluate from the elution plate to the designated final plate.
